subject.title: /think off doesn't disable thinking on claude-cli — inherits Claude Code's default effort (contradicts docs)

question: Should Claude CLI `/think off` make OpenClaw the authoritative owner of `MAX_THINKING_TOKENS` for gateway-spawned runs, clearing inherited values to guarantee disabled thinking while accepting the documented node-placed limitation?
rationale: The docs already promise disabled thinking, but the proposed fix intentionally changes how an operator-set Claude Code environment variable is inherited; that compatibility and ownership boundary requires maintainer intent.

options.title: Adopt deterministic off semantics
options.body: Accept the linked PR direction: OpenClaw clears inherited thinking-token settings and injects disabled thinking for supported gateway-spawned Claude CLI runs, with tested model exceptions.

options.title: Preserve ambient Claude Code ownership
options.body: Keep inherited Claude Code settings authoritative and revise the CLI profile and documentation so `off` is not advertised as a guaranteed disabled state.

recommendation.title: Adopt deterministic off semantics
recommendation.body: Accept the linked PR direction: OpenClaw clears inherited thinking-token settings and injects disabled thinking for supported gateway-spawned Claude CLI runs, with tested model exceptions.
